reason: I'd probably throw my old chat archive at the free 40 just to see if anything was off, but paying every month for it, no. I check receipts when something smells wrong, and so far scrolling the group and asking my foreman has been good enough.
objection: It's another monthly bill for something I could patch together with Excel or a cheap bot, and on a big job with lots of material runs I'd go through 100 documents fast and end up on the $45 plan.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial on my old chats turned up a real duplicate or a padded material receipt worth more than a year of the subscription, I'd pay without arguing.
